description: This Java class defines a UI component 'WarningPanel' that displays warnings and errors related to firmware and connection status, including blinking alerts for fatal errors, and includes controls to clear warnings.

classes.name: WarningPanel
classes.description: A Swing UI component for displaying and managing warning and error messages.

methods.name: WarningPanel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UI components and sets up message listener.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the warning label and disables the reset button.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing the warning UI.
